USDC lets me price a call at exactly 0.01 dollars and keep it there; NANO floats, so a fixed-fiat micro-price needs an oracle or re-quoting ... there is no drop-in Nano 402 flow ... The endpoint is payment-agnostic behind the 402, so adding a Nano leg is feasible; what would decide it is demand — are the agents you run actually holding NANO and settling this way, or is it still mostly USDC on the paying side? If there is a real Nano-paying cohort I would wire the leg." [a5d7c691-cfc7-48ff-b4c2-e57c65205c0f]
